name: Fearmonger
ability: Each night, choose a player: if you nominate & execute them, their team loses. All players know if you choose a new player.
interaction: Chooses any player; told nothing. If the choice differs from the current Fear target, all players are told that the Fearmonger chose a new player (not who).
drunk_or_poisoned: If drunk or poisoned when choosing, the choice has no effect (the Storyteller may still announce it); if drunk or poisoned at the execution, the target's team does not lose.

jinxes.text: If the Storyteller would gain the Fearmonger ability, a Minion gains it, and learns this.

rulings.text: On the first night all players learn a player was chosen; afterwards only a new choice is announced.
Only the current Fear target counts; earlier targets no longer do.
If the target is executed but does not die, their team still loses.
Only applies if the Fearmonger nominated the target.
If the target is evil (e.g. a Baron chosen via Poppy Grower confusion) and is executed, evil loses.

test_scenarios.name: evil wins
test_scenarios.setup: Seats: Fen Fearmonger, Gil Imp, Hal Butler, Ivy Chef, Jo Empath.
test_scenarios.actions: Night 1: Fen chooses Hal. Day 1: Fen nominates Hal; Hal executed.

test_scenarios.name: other player executed
test_scenarios.actions: Night 1: Fen chooses Ivy. Day 1: Fen nominates Hal; Hal executed.

test_scenarios.name: switch announced
test_scenarios.actions: Night 1 Hal; Night 2 Ivy; Night 3 Ivy.
test_scenarios.expected: Announcement after nights 1 and 2, not night 3; only Ivy has Fear.

test_scenarios.name: evil target
test_scenarios.setup: Seats: Fen Fearmonger, Gil Imp, Kim Baron, Ivy Chef, Jo Empath.
test_scenarios.actions: Night 1: Fen chooses Kim. Day 1: Fen nominates Kim; Kim executed.

test_scenarios.name: poisoned Fearmonger
test_scenarios.setup: Seats: Fen Fearmonger, Gil Imp, Hal Butler, Lu Sailor, Ivy Chef.
test_scenarios.actions: Night 1: Lu chooses Fen and the Storyteller makes Fen drunk; Fen chooses Hal. Day 1: Fen nominates Hal; Hal executed.

test_scenarios.name: not nominated by Fearmonger
test_scenarios.actions: Night 1: Fen chooses Hal. Day 1: Ivy nominates Hal; Hal executed.
